ios.desc:
Lingo Real turns your real life into language lessons — and gives you a friendly AI partner to practice speaking with every day.

SPEAK WITH CONFIDENCE
• Talk with Lily, Leo or Lingo in real-life scenarios: ordering coffee, checking in at a hotel, a job interview, meeting new friends.
• Get gentle corrections with a clear explanation in your own language after every answer.
• See a pronunciation score for each sentence, word by word.

YOUR PERSONAL PATH
• A daily plan built around your goals and level — travel, work, exams or everyday conversation.
• Every day brings a topic with useful phrases, a real dialogue, games, speaking and writing practice.
• Type any topic — or snap a photo of the things around you — and Lingo Real creates a lesson for you.

PRACTICE THAT STICKS
• 7 ways to practice each topic: Quick Start, Flashcards, Play, Dialogue, Speaking, Writing and RolePlay.
• Writing feedback with a score, a corrected version and tips.
• Smart review brings words back right before you forget them.
• Streaks, daily goals, widgets and Live Activities keep you on track.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• On supported devices, AI features run on your iPhone or iPad with Apple Intelligence, so your practice stays private.
• Speech recognition happens on your device.

MANY LANGUAGES
Learn English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Portuguese, Vietnamese and more. The app itself is available in 12 languages.

LINGO REAL PREMIUM
Unlimited AI lessons, conversations and hearts, every story free to play, and a free streak freeze every week. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

With Apple Intelligence on a supported device, AI features run on your device. On other devices, the AI tutor is included with Premium.
